Mumbai Port Authority Announces Projects for Infrastructure and Tourism

The Mumbai Port Authority has announced a series of projects aimed at enhancing both waterfront tourism and port capacity. One report indicates 63 projects valued at ₹5,028 crore, while another mentions projects worth ₹3,541 crore. These initiatives are intended to boost the port's cargo handling capabilities and promote tourism in the area. The expansion reflects an effort to develop the port's infrastructure and economic potential.
